items.text: This item has had 5 workshop rounds with zero user responses across 12+ decisions. The plan remains entirely TBD — no description, archive materials, scope, or tags were ever provided. No further automated refinement is possible. The item needs either user input (answer round-001 d1 at minimum) or a disposition decision (round-005 d1).

items.context: This is a final consolidation of the core question asked across all prior rounds. The item has no description and no user engagement after 5 rounds. Only one action is needed to unblock: choose a path forward.

options.label: Define it — provide a description and answer round-001 decisions
options.rationale: Update spec.json with a description (swarm-manager backlog update --kind idea --name effort-test --data '{"description":"..."}'), then answer round-001 decisions d1-d5. Re-run initialization afterward.

options.label: Archive it
options.rationale: swarm-manager backlog update --kind idea --name effort-test --data '{"status":"archived"}'. Preserves history, removes from active backlog.

options.label: Delete it
options.rationale: swarm-manager backlog delete --kind idea --name effort-test. Removes entirely — appropriate if this was a workflow test.

plan_updates: No plan.md changes — still fully TBD. Blocked on foundational input since round 1. Round 6 provides a final consolidated disposition decision with actionable CLI commands for each option.
